name: sandcastle-kit
description: Shared Sandcastle setup: one base image, one orchestrator, per-project config.

scripts.test: export GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=1 GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0=commit.gpgsign GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0=false && bash test/status.test.sh && tsx --test --test-timeout=300000 test/*.test.ts
scripts.test:shard: export GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=1 GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0=commit.gpgsign GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0=false && files=$(tsx test/shard.ts) && tsx --test --test-timeout=300000 $files
